final: WITH department_counts AS (SELECT major.department AS department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id GROUP BY major.department), department_shares AS (SELECT department, member_count, member_count * 1.0 / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM department_counts) SELECT department, member_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average FROM department_shares WHERE share >= (SELECT AVG(share) FROM department_shares)
